activity_summary: You stood in the porch after a sermon of one turn. Master Thwaite had read the heads of Friday's proclamation. The Mayor's pew had halberds and a new man behind. You saw the empty pew in the north aisle and said you would put no cross in the almanac. A neighbour said half the better sort had gone out of the City. Sir John spoke only the responses.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once, and refused the mark.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Read the heads and stopped when the glass was done.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Let you look once, and took you toward dinner.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Stood behind the halberds and gave the responses. He did not speak to you.

entities.name: the proclamation
entities.context: Mentioned in One turning of the glass

facets.activity: Stood through one turn of the sermon

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: No cross. The mark is for a day I see her
